cat > build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
rw=Chem.RWMol()

def atom(el, aromatic=False, charge=0):
    a=Chem.Atom(el); a.SetFormalCharge(charge); a.SetIsAromatic(aromatic)
    idx=rw.AddAtom(a); return idx

def bond(i,j,typ=Chem.BondType.SINGLE): rw.AddBond(i,j,typ)
def cycle(atoms, typ=Chem.BondType.AROMATIC):
    for i,j in zip(atoms,atoms[1:]+atoms[:1]): bond(i,j,typ)

# central Hf
hf=atom('Hf')
# aluminum later

# Two aryl rings
upper=[atom('C',True) for _ in range(6)]; cycle(upper)
lower=[atom('C',True) for _ in range(6)]; cycle(lower)
# phenoxide O donors
O1=atom('O', charge=-1); bond(upper[0],O1); bond(O1,hf,Chem.BondType.DATIVE)
O2=atom('O', charge=-1); bond(lower[0],O2); bond(O2,hf,Chem.BondType.DATIVE)
# upper chelating arm: Ar-CH2-CH2-N(Me) -> Hf

def amine_arm(ring, pos):
    c1=atom('C'); c2=atom('C'); n=atom('N'); me=atom('C')
    bond(ring[pos],c1); bond(c1,c2); bond(c2,n); bond(n,me)
    bond(n,hf,Chem.BondType.DATIVE)
    return n
N1=amine_arm(upper,1)
N2=amine_arm(lower,1)
# Hf-alkyl
methyl=atom('C'); bond(hf,methyl)
# Carbazole fused system N-coupled to upper ring at pos 5
cn=atom('N',True)
a,b,c,d=[atom('C',True) for _ in range(4)]
cycle([cn,a,b,c,d])
e,f,g,h=[atom('C',True) for _ in range(4)]
cycle([a,e,f,g,h,b])
i,j,k,l=[atom('C',True) for _ in range(4)]
cycle([c,i,j,k,l,d])
bond(upper[5],cn)
# N-substituted indole, attached via pyrrole N to lower ring pos2; methyl on C2
inN=atom('N',True)
A,B,C,D=[atom('C',True) for _ in range(4)]
cycle([inN,A,B,C,D])
E,F,G,H=[atom('C',True) for _ in range(4)]
cycle([C,E,F,G,H,D])
bond(lower[2],inN)
ime=atom('C'); bond(A,ime)
# add Al and three methyl ligands as separate; bridge methyl is attached by a single bond to Hf & Al though model as carbon with 2 H
al=atom('Al')
bridge=atom('C'); bond(hf,bridge); bond(al,bridge)
for _ in range(2):
    cme=atom('C'); bond(al,cme)

mol=rw.GetMol()
try:
    Chem.SanitizeMol(mol)
    print('sanitized',mol.GetNumAtoms())
except Exception as e:
    print('sanitize error',e)
    raise
mol=Chem.AddHs(mol)
print('atoms with H',mol.GetNumAtoms())
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=18; params.maxIterations=1000
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol,params)
print('embed',res)
if res<0:
    params.useRandomCoords=True
    print('retry',AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol,params))
# save raw xyz
conf=mol.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f'{mol.GetNumAtoms()}\nGenerated structure\n')
    for i,a in enumerate(mol.GetAtoms()):
        p=conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
        f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .6f} {p.y: .6f} {p.z: .6f}\n')
# report donor/metal distances
for i in [hf,O1,O2,N1,N2,methyl,al,bridge]:
 p=conf.GetAtomPosition(i); print(i,mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol(),tuple(round(x,2) for x in p))
for i in [O1,O2,N1,N2,methyl,bridge,al]:
 p=conf.GetAtomPosition(i); q=conf.GetAtomPosition(hf); print('dist hf',i,p.Distance(q))
PY
